name: Revenue-linked incentives -> fraud risk over revenue
rationale: Material revenue-linked incentives give management a motive to manipulate revenue, and manual journals and period-end discretion provide the opportunity. The rule directs analytics tied to target mechanics, journal entry testing, and corroborated inquiry - with explicit warnings against presuming fraud.
